0022600229.text: The Mavericks (7-4, 9th in the West, winners of three straight) visit the Timberwolves (8-3, 5th in the West, winners of four straight) in Dallas's 12th game of the season, with both teams 7-3 over their last ten and Dallas 2-2 on the road. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), while Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a leg injury and a game-time decision. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and the Mavericks have not yet met the Timberwolves this season after losing all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 124-94 in Dallas.
